source_scope: Saved Daily Close/registry evidence; official spot-check CPI, payrolls and PCE. Other primary links as saved, not all independently re-verified.

method.purpose: Within-macro relative POTENTIAL transmission priority, not a comparable financial impact magnitude or calibrated probability.

axes.transmission_relevance: 0 none,1 remote,2 meaningful macro pathway,3 direct rates/discount broad financing or key labor/price anchor
axes.comparable_surprise_or_change: 0 no validated comparable,1 reported within-series trend or small known consensus deviation,2 explicit same-period consensus-supported material direction; no implied significance thresholds
axes.incremental_information: 0 largely same-period/correlated corroboration,1 distinct but partially overlapping,2 primary independent anchor (NOT statistical independence)
axes.source_reliability: 0 unsupported,1 secondary/provisional or primary numeric gap,2 original issuer/statistical source documented in saved records

method.rank: Competition ranking: 1 + number of other MACRO_ONLY events scoring higher; no cross-family comparisons
method.direction: Rising rate/funding costs can increase AI CapEx financial pressure; stronger real demand tends to offset reversal risk. Single announcement may affect both in opposite directions.
method.combination: Combine by causal channels; select anchor and treat related releases as corroboration/contradiction. Never sum raw headlines, these ordinal scores, consensus surprises or CPI/PCE/ISM price data.

rows.title: September durable goods release
rows.saved_observation: Headline +1.8% MoM; core capital goods orders +0.5% MoM (secondary; official numerical PDF not collected)
rows.dependence_limit: Secondary actuals; aircraft distort headline; not verified AI capex
rows.comparability: Ex-aircraft +0.5%; original release PDF still uncollected
rows.qualitative_note: Low direct AI link; source verification gap

rows.title: October FOMC hold
rows.saved_observation: Target unchanged at 3.75–4.00%; 10–2 vote, two preferred +25bp
rows.dependence_limit: Hold broadly anticipated; no matched policy-path surprise or post-release rate reaction
rows.comparability: State of policy, not measured repricing
rows.qualitative_note: Strong structural funding channel; absent unexpected announcement

rows.title: Q3 GDP advance
rows.saved_observation: +3.4% SAAR vs +2.2% previous; private domestic final sales +4.9% SAAR
rows.dependence_limit: Unverified exact same-vintage consensus; GDP combines components also appearing in durable/ISM
rows.comparability: Compared to Q2, not consensus surprise

rows.title: September PCE/inflation
rows.saved_observation: Headline +0.5% MoM / +3.6% YoY; core +0.3% MoM / +3.1% YoY
rows.dependence_limit: Correlated with October CPI but distinct month/basket; no verified same-vintage forecast
rows.qualitative_note: Rate-pressure evidence; must not add to CPI as independent identical shock

rows.title: October manufacturing PMI
rows.saved_observation: 55.5 vs previous 54.5 and forecast 54.6; prices paid 75.2
rows.dependence_limit: Survey diffusion, not dollars; overlaps GDP / durable sector activity
rows.qualitative_note: Broad manufacturing strength plus price input costs

rows.title: September 2026 JOLTS release
rows.dependence_limit: September labor measure older than October payrolls; overlapping labor cycle
rows.qualitative_note: Useful labor breadth, not additional independent labor-policy shock

rows.title: October 2026 ADP US private employment report
rows.saved_observation: +86k private payrolls; different sample from BLS official NFP
rows.dependence_limit: Same labor period as October NFP; ADP and NFP cannot be added as jobs or separate policy shocks
rows.comparability: No verified pre-release consensus in saved audit
rows.qualitative_note: Corroborating, not independently additive to NFP

rows.title: Nov 4 provisional congressional-control election outcome
rows.saved_observation: AP/Reuters projection of split political control; not certified and no law executed
rows.dependence_limit: Market narrative/policy expectations only; no enacted AI infrastructure regulation or fiscal change
rows.comparability: No implemented policy or verified sector-specific causal impulse
rows.qualitative_note: Potential future policy risk, current signed economic effect UNKNOWN

rows.title: October 2026 US ISM Services PMI official release
rows.saved_observation: 54.5 vs prior 54.9 and forecast 54.8; prices paid 73.0
rows.dependence_limit: Correlated with manufacturing PMI and broad GDP; no immediate cash effect
rows.comparability: Modest -0.3 index point vs vendor forecast

rows.title: 2026 Q3 preliminary nonfarm productivity +3.6%, unit labor costs -0.7%
rows.series: Q3 nonfarm productivity / unit labor cost
rows.saved_observation: Productivity +3.6% SAAR vs forecast +2.8%; unit labor costs -0.7% vs +0.6% expected
rows.dependence_limit: Economy-wide productivity is not AI compute cost per task
rows.comparability: +0.8pp productivity and -1.3pp labor cost vs cited consensus
rows.qualitative_note: Offsetting evidence against broad cost inflation

rows.title: October 2026 Employment Situation: +165k payrolls, 4.1% unemployment
rows.saved_observation: +165k NFP vs +65k Reuters expectation; unemployment 4.1%; wages +0.4% MoM
rows.dependence_limit: Stronger growth supports demand but raises higher-for-longer possibility; not AI-specific
rows.comparability: +100k jobs surprise against Reuters poll; revisions +84k
rows.qualitative_note: Largest incremental labor anchor for cutoff; opposite rate and demand effects

rows.title: October 2026 CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m
rows.saved_observation: Headline +0.4% MoM vs +0.6% September; core +0.3% MoM; October YoY UNKNOWN
rows.dependence_limit: October 2025 YoY inputs unavailable; no verified same-vintage CPI consensus; correlated with PCE price data
rows.comparability: Sequential slowdown September +0.6% to October +0.4%, not pre-release surprise
rows.qualitative_note: Latest inflation anchor but no reliable October YoY or post-CPI yield transmission

aggregate.potential_direction: Elevated financing/discount-rate headwind, partially offset by resilient macro demand and productivity. Sign and size of NET AI CapEx reversal effect remain UNKNOWN.

channels.economic_path: restrictive policy/yields -> financing cost and duration valuations -> potential future R4 issuer stress; not an executed project cancellation
broad demand resilience lowers generic collapse risk; not proof of AI project-level payback
core inflation pressures rate path but slower latest CPI and lower labor unit costs offset; PCE and CPI measure correlated baskets at different dates
provisional election outcome may change policy probabilities only after documented proposed/implemented regulation

causal_overlaps: October ADP and official NFP are alternative labor measures; do not add headcounts or event weights
JOLTS September is an older labor-demand series, corroborates October labor but not a second independent rates shock
September PCE and October CPI are different inflation benchmarks and monthly horizons; use temporal sequence and latest verified anchor
Manufacturing and Services PMI overlap aggregate GDP real-activity evidence; correlated survey subcomponents are not independent macro shocks
FOMC decision is reaction function responding to employment/inflation; including both as additive rate effects double counts transmission
Election outcome is conditional policy exposure, not realized AI project cost

scenarios.name: BASE_CONDITIONAL
scenarios.premises: restrictive policy persists, demand and capacity remain resilient
scenarios.potential_effect: MIXED: funding drag, no proved AI CapEx reversal
scenarios.missing_trigger: matched neocloud/hyperscaler funding repricing and issuer cash conversion

scenarios.name: DOWNSIDE
scenarios.premises: inflation persists while demand declines and AI issuer credit widens independently
scenarios.missing_trigger: observed same-instrument credit spread/covenant issue, cash deterioration or executed funded-project change

scenarios.name: UPSIDE
scenarios.premises: inflation softens, yields/credit ease and paid AI capacity keeps expanding
scenarios.missing_trigger: comparable primary policy yields, AI debt conditions and paid deployment

aggregate.macro_pain_note: Reference only: existing wider macro-pain panel contains M1–M4 Treasury, inflation, commodities, IG credit and missingness. Do not add event-rank scores to 18–62 or interpret this as new score.
